tools.name: get_top_social_casinos
tools.description: Return the current Social Casino Index toplist of US social and sweepstakes casinos, in the same order as the socialcasinoindex.com homepage. Each entry has the signup bonus, first-purchase offer, daily reward, payout time, redemption minimums and dated source links.

tools.name: get_social_casino

tools.name: check_state_availability
